rate_scale: unit interval; percentage-valued source columns are divided by 100
rationale: The underwater task contains a native high-cost region, so its reward and operational cost are defined independently of the baseline implementation.

checkpoint_shortlist.ranking: descending reward gain of the best feasible CALF mode over the bare backbone

sooper_screening.selection: highest mean development reward among feasible settings

scenario_selection.desired_development_ordering: CALF-Wrapper > SOOPER > bare backbone in reward
scenario_selection.calf_constraint: goal-reaching and constraint-satisfaction rates no lower than SOOPER
scenario_selection.fallback_when_ordering_fails: strongest transparent Pareto or efficiency comparison; exact ordering is not required
